releases.body:
## What's Changed

- **Fix:** `jules_get_source` broken URL encoding (was 404-ing on all calls)
- **Enhancement:** `jules_status` now surfaces all activity types (agentMessaged, userMessaged, planApproved, sessionFailed, artifacts summary, session state, PR title/description)
- **Enhancement:** `jules_list` now includes session `state`, `createTime`, `updateTime`
- **Enhancement:** `jules_list_sources` now includes `id` and `isPrivate`
- **Docs:** SKILL.md setup guide covers global install path
- **Chore:** `.gitignore` updated
- **API:** Verified against latest jules.google/docs/api/reference

releases.name: v0.5.9 — Example session in README
releases.body: Added anonymized example session to README showing a real opencode-jules flow: user prompt → skill activation → jules_list_sources → jules_create → session result.

releases.name: v0.5.8 — OpenCode REST plugin for Jules
releases.body:
### Branding update
- Renamed to **OpenCode REST plugin** to emphasize REST API + API key approach
- Added comparison table vs `@google/jules-mcp` in README

### Key differentiators
- No MCP server required — just an API key in `.env`
- All 9 REST API endpoints as opencode tools
- Built-in skill (`/opencode-jules`) with help, setup, and workflow guidance

releases.name: v0.5.6 — CI: build-only, manual publish
releases.body: Removed `publish-npm` job from workflow. Publishing handled manually via `npm publish`.

releases.name: v0.5.5 — Fix CI: remove missing npm test script
releases.body: Removed `npm test` from the GitHub Actions workflow since no test script is defined in package.json.
